judgments.reason: The span occurs literally and supports chylothorax, but it does not support lymphoma as the etiology.
The span occurs literally and the B-lymphocyte population in sampled lymph nodes supports a B-cell lymphoma etiology.
The span occurs literally and aberrant BCL2 expression supports the documented B-cell lymphoid malignancy.
The span occurs literally and elevated Ki-67 supports a proliferative lymphoid neoplasm consistent with lymphoma.
